title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_context: Welcomes the EMA’s intention to adopt a new ‘guideline on inclusion of pregnant and breastfeeding individuals in clinical trials’ without compromising the safety of the expecting individual and child; urges the EMA to adopt similar guidelines to improve the inclusion of other vulnerable and under-represented communities, for example older women and gender-diverse and intersex people, as well as ethnic minorities and marginalised communities;
